summary: These are funds provided by Lolland Municipality to support cultural activities of associations. The funds aim to strengthen cultural life and contribute to a vibrant community by subsidizing various cultural projects and events.

deadlines.application_deadline: Check annually on the website (usually early in the year)
deadlines.decided_at: Usually several months after deadline, specific dates vary

reporting_requirements: Applicants must provide documentation of how the funds were used.
Report on the results of the funded activity may be required.
